title: Namely - Missing ATS and pulse surveys, with product direction concerns post-acquisition
clean_text: Reviewers note functional gaps that prevent Namely from being a true all-in-one solution, including no pulse surveys and no applicant tracking system (ATS); its payroll tool is better suited to less complex organizations and can struggle with complex time-and-attendance or multi-FEIN scenarios. Custom integrations are reportedly not easy to build given limited professional services resources, and support uses a pod-based model that has led to slow response times for some customers. Some reviewers raised concerns about product direction after Namely was acquired by a benefits brokerage, with one stating the technology "definitely took a backseat" afterward.
